title: Read the RESP Client
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Read the RESP Client.
learning_objectives: Explain read the resp client using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for read the resp client
Assess failure and operational limits of read the resp client
concepts_covered: RESP is Redis's length-prefixed command/reply protocol; this project implements only a small subset.
respClient writes arrays/bulk strings and parses simple, error, integer, and bulk replies.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
